answer: Bind each voting seat to a registered motor vehicle. The operator links a VIN that a state DMV title ties to their name, and one VIN can back only one seat, whether it is a velvet-trimmed sedan or a rusty river-camp pickup. Honest operators already own a car, so the check is nearly free for them. A clone farmer wanting 100 extra votes must title 100 cars: even at $300 per junker plus $150 in fees, that is $45,000, a steep ledge to climb for seats that each earn far less.
